stories.title: install.py transaction engine and Claude Code projection

completion.statement: install.py (stdlib) transaction engine and the Claude Code projection are implemented: in-memory write plan with before/after hashes, conflict refusal with zero writes (unowned collisions, modified managed files, tampered block markers, symlink escapes, malformed settings), --allow-overwrite with 0700/0600 backups, a bounded fcntl install lock with before-hash rechecks, atomic writes with rollback, and the ownership manifest written last against schemas/installation.schema.json. Settings merges preserve all user keys/hooks/permissions; CLAUDE.md gets a managed block; .gitignore gains only volatile entries and never the committed context home (nothing under .software-factory/context/ is written or listed in the manifest). Dry-run writes nothing and spawns nothing; a second install is a byte-level no-op; Git and HOME configs are never touched; no active.json is created. The Claude projection mirrors the 11 skills into .claude/skills with argument-hint on all and disable-model-invocation on the six entry/admin skills, copies the 11 role agents, and merges SessionStart/PreCompact hook commands with stderr merged into stdout (2>&1).
evidence: python3 -m unittest tests.test_installer tests.test_host_claude (32 tests OK)
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (338 tests OK after board projection rebuild)
uvx --from ruff==0.17.0 ruff check . (all checks passed); python3 scripts/validate.py (ok); python3 scripts/scan_public.py (180 files, no hits)

stories.title: Override refuses tampered receipts and reaches the documented end state

completion.statement: sf_eval.py override is now integrity-preserving: it recomputes the receipt self-hash exactly as verify does before recording anything and refuses a mismatch (exit 1, no write, receipt path and stored/recomputed digests named), so a tampered receipt can never be laundered into a verifying one; and an approved override of a digest-valid failing receipt appends the who/when/why record (plus from_verdict), transitions the verdict to pass with the case results untouched as evidence, and re-hashes, so verify and verify-manifest accept the overridden receipt citing the new digest — the end state receipts.md documents. receipts.md and SKILL.md now state these semantics. Three new OverrideTests cover the tampered-receipt refusal (live receipt and the shipped tampered fixture, each byte-identical afterwards) and the overridden-failing end state through verify-manifest. The full sha is recorded in the board record history for story 36.
